title: Chronicle Config v1
description: PC-owned config.json; phone never reads this file

layout_version.description: Vault folder layout version. Phase 4 file-once requires 2; process/serve refuse mismatch with a loud error.

vault_mirror.description: DEPRECATED — open Chronicle vault root in Obsidian instead; if set, one-way copy of derived notes/ (edits overwritten)

ollama.description: Ollama connection and generation options (PC-only); embeddings always use Ollama

num_ctx.description: Default context window when callers omit num_ctx (Ornith supports up to 262K; recall/ask use higher per-task values)

temperature.description: When set, globally overrides per-feature temperatures; null keeps call-site defaults

llm.description: Chat/vision provider selection (PC-only). Secrets stay in ~/.config/chronicle/secrets.json — never vault config.json

provider.description: Active chat/vision provider; embed remains Ollama nomic-embed-text @ 768

cloud_consent.description: Opt-in: journal/KB text may leave this machine when provider is grok|vertex

vision_cloud_consent.description: Separate opt-in for sending images to cloud providers

model.description: Optional Grok model id; falls back to models.llm

project.description: GCP project id (non-secret); credentials via ADC

model.description: Optional Vertex model id; falls back to models.llm

timezone.description: Fallback timezone for malformed entry timestamps only

e2ee.description: Opt-in field-level encryption for entry text (v1.11). kdf/check are non-secret; the passphrase is never stored. PC-owned like config.json itself.

check.description: AES-GCM blob of a fixed known plaintext — verifies a passphrase without storing it.
